data: What is the value of the y-axis for the dashed black line at model capacity 500?

The y-axis represents accuracy, and the dashed black line corresponds to MTL-Avg. The caption mentions that the figure shows cross-validation to choose the best performing model capacity for each model. The y-axis values range from approximately 0.6 to 0.9. At model capacity 500, the dashed black line appears to be around 0.9. Therefore, the value of the y-axis for the dashed black line at model capacity 500 is approximately 0.9.
